Notes.Text:
This update for pi-coding-agent fixes the following issues:

Changes in pi-coding-agent:

Update to version 1.3.0:

  * /share destination selectable via sessionShareDestination
    (auto, gist or radius)
  * GPT-6 thinking-level changes keep the prompt cache; Kimi Code
    via Chat Completions keeps it when tools are added mid-chat
    (base URL overrides now need /v1)
  * Model switching drops the previous model's thinking; resumed
    sessions keep active tools with --tools +/- applied on top
  * Internal Pi dependencies pinned to exact versions; --model
    prefers the provider with credentials
  * Fixed codemode Bun interrupt and worker leaks, read line
    labels, prompt-template empty args, tool-call parsing,
    Anthropic/Bedrock image errors, OpenCode Go endpoints,
    gateway retries, Gemini/Vertex and Xiaomi thinking levels,
    plus Nix and overlay fixes
  * Many more fixes and improvements; see upstream's release notes
    for the full list

- Refresh the vendored node_modules 1.2.0 -> 1.3.0: the six
  @earendil-works packages move to 1.3.0. 117 shipped modules
  and the licence union is unchanged

Update to version 1.2.0:

  * Per-key OpenRouter model lists with the key's context size,
    max output and prices, including regional endpoints
  * Published $schema for settings, models, keybindings and
    themes; theme schema moved and validated on startup
  * PI_CLIPBOARD_OSC52=1 copies to the remote clipboard over
    sessions Pi cannot detect
  * Codemode shows input constraints and run elapsed/total time
  * before_agent_start also fires for extension-triggered runs;
    handlers must check event.messageType, and the session counts
    as busy while a run starts
  * Changed pi mcp list --json resources report, thinking blocks
    omitted from serialization, terminal cursor only
  * Fixed Mistral timeout aborting streams, symlinked AGENTS.md in
    worktrees, codemode @options/timeout and quadratic text join,
    print-mode truncation exit, MCP resources and OAuth, plus
    terminal, keybinding and overlay fixes
  * Many more fixes and improvements; see upstream's release notes
    for the full list

- Refresh the vendored node_modules 1.1.0 -> 1.2.0: the six
  @earendil-works packages move to 1.2.0 and
  @earendil-works/chord is dropped upstream. 117 shipped modules
  and the licence union is unchanged
  * Rebase pi-use-modular-runtime.patch for the removed ./client
    exports

Update to version 1.1.0:

  * Program status reporting via OSC 7501: supported terminals and
    dashboards see whether pi is working, blocked, done or failed
  * Claude Haiku 5.5 (anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5) with adaptive
    thinking up to xhigh/max effort
  * --tools takes +name/-name entries adjusting the default tool
    selection instead of replacing it
  * GPT-6 Luna as classifier model via Decisions API; codemode
    models.classify() accepts images for supporting classifiers
  * Native llama.cpp decision models (Julia-1, Laya, Kev, lev,
    OpenJev) as classifiers via /v1/systemone
  * Changed: outputPad also applies to ! output, tool output and
    summary blocks; pi mcp login --timeout limits the whole sign-in
  * Fixed MCP OAuth cancellation/timeouts, /mcp live updates, bash
    result timing, image resize under node --watch, clipboard in
    Termux, plus provider retries (Bedrock thinking, Mistral
    finish_reason error, server_busy) and Anthropic login fallback
  * Many more fixes and improvements; see upstream's release notes
    for the full list

- Refresh the vendored node_modules 1.0.4 -> 1.1.0: the ten
  @earendil-works packages move to 1.1.0; @babel/runtime and
  @smithy/core move too inside the shipped tree, picomatch,
  rolldown and vite only in the dev tree. Still 119 shipped
  modules and the licence union is unchanged
